name: web-3d-modeling-workflow
title_zh: 浏览器里搭三维场景，改到跟参考图严丝合缝
tagline_zh: 不用开 Blender，直接在网页里调构图、材质、灯光。拿参考图当标尺，几何、交互、性能按风险分级查，改到像为止。
tagline_en: Skip Blender. Tune composition, materials, lighting right in the browser. Match reference dioramas, risk-check.
desc_en: Build and refine HTML/WebGL/Three.js scenes, reference-matched dioramas, and procedural assets. Prioritize composition, shape, materials and lighting; verify geometry, interaction and delivery with risk-based browser QA. Also supports reusable asset systems and measured performance work. Not for Blender-only pipelines or static 2D illustrations.
why_zh: 把「像不像」当验收标准，用参考图对齐而非凭感觉。浏览器即战场，改完立刻看效果，不切软件不打断心流。
why_en: Treats reference-match as the spec, not vibes. Iterate in the same browser you ship in—no context-switching, no export.
limit_zh: 只认 HTML/WebGL/Three.js 场景，纯 Blender 管线或静态 2D 插画不接。不产出最终渲染图。
limit_en: Only HTML/WebGL/Three.js scenes. No Blender-only pipelines or static 2D. Delivers runnable code, not final renders.
title_en: Build & refine 3D scenes in browser, matched to reference
